Description:
[center][b][size=5][/size][/b][/center][left][/left][left](Do report if there are some issues with the mod itself or with compatibility so that i can try fixing them)

(This is my first stardew mod, so I am no expert but i'm doing my best.)[/left][left][b][size=5]﻿New Buildings[/size][/b][/left][img]https://i.imgur.com/2t8A7Xb.png[/img] ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/6whTLlk.png[/img]

[list]

[/size][list]

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Joja/Qi station[/size]

[list]

[/list][size=3][spoiler]Adds value to the slime eggs by enriching them [/spoiler] [/size]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]BFAV friends[/size]
[/list][size=3][spoiler]A new building designed to welcome 20 animals with autofeed function (should work for barn/coop/BFAV animals from vanilla and other mods (but not for animals from the monster den)[/spoiler] [/size]

[size=5][b]Compatibility/issues
[/b][/size][size=3]
[list]
[*][size=3]Should be compatible with all the big expansion mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Autofeed is actually 100%free since SF does not support vanilla autofeed system ([s]i did try it[/s]) / you are free to disable it in config but you will need to feed animals manually (placing hay by hand).[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Should be compatible[/b] with other farmcave/farmhouse/cellar mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Should be compatible with other custom buildings mod[/size]
[/list]--> If it doesn't work out well, just set the farmcave options to false in the config and it should go back to whatever it was after sleeping once.[list]
[*][size=3]Tell me if locations overlapp so that I can add compatibility[/size]
[*][size=3]A few issues seem to be inherent to BFAV but they should fix themselves by sleeping 1 day.[/size]
[*][size=3]As Anna0009 and other people reported on Discord, [b]does not work on android.[/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b]Tractor mod and Custom furniture are incompatible with solid foundation (will affect custom buildings)[/b][/size]
[/list][/size]

[b][size=5]FAQ
[/size][/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]Can be installed on an existing save[/b] without problem
[*]There are [b]config options[/b] for Farmcave/ Farmhouse compatibility with other mods.
[*][b]Buildings are Bought at Robin[/b] and Wizard, some are unlocked after some events.
[*]Animals are bought from Marnie, and some special shops.
[*]Some upgrades are [b]unlocked after events[/b]/ quests.
[*]Golden walnuts are renewable (parrots and forage).
[*]Some building [b]sprites are wrong in shops[/b] but fully functional once built.
[*]Suggestions can be made as I intend to expand upon this mod.
[*]All changes are [b]reversible[/b] so you don't risk to ruin your map / save with this mod
[*]Leftover quests after removing the mod can be removed with the vanilla command: removequest questID
[/list][/spoiler]
